build_conformer_encoder: build a ConformerEncoder with idim, n_layers_enc, n_head, d_model, and kernel_size for audio feature extraction
create_conv2d_subsampling: create a Conv2dSubsampling layer that downsamples audio input by 4x with two conv layers and a linear projection
create_rel_positional_encoding: create a RelPositionalEncoding module that generates relative position embeddings for sequence inputs
create_rel_pos_emb_conformer_block: create a RelPosEmbConformerBlock with feed-forward, multi-head attention, and convolution sub-layers
create_rel_pos_multi_head_attention: create a RelPosMultiHeadAttention layer with relative positional bias for self-attention computation
